outline: This course explores art collection through significant visual and material from civilization. The course is designed based on the concept of "time as the warp, materials as the weft," introducing the scope and diversity of material culture studies. By incorporating diverse museum collections, objects, materials, and documents, this course aims to break through the boundaries of academic specialization, making material culture to be the part of aesthetics education for a broader audience. The course not only allows students to engage with the latest scholarly developments but also encourages them to recognize that culture can be narrated not only through textual sources, but also through material and visual culture, which are equally vital mediums for recording and interpreting the past.
